title: Sheaves as a Means of Maintaining Consistency in Model-based Systems Engineering
summary: We propose that the sheaf condition on a presheaf of design spaces provides a mathematical model for multi-view consistency in the architecture of cyber-physical systems (CPS). In model-based systems engineering, multiple engineering views -- electrical, thermal, mechanical, and software -- must be kept mutually consistent, yet current practice relies on informal procedures without a precise semantic account of global consistency.
